tool.name: nf-core wittyer
tool.description: A large variant benchmarking tool analogous to hap.py for small variants.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ mkdir bench
dotnet /opt/Wittyer/Wittyer.dll \\ -t ${truth_vcf} \\ -i ${query_vcf} \\ -o bench \\ ${regions} \\ ${config_file} \\ ${args}
mv bench/Wittyer.Stats.json ${prefix}.json mv bench/*.vcf.gz ${prefix}.vcf.gz mv bench/*.vcf.gz.tbi ${prefix}.vcf.gz.tbi

cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": wittyer: \$(dotnet /opt/Wittyer/Wittyer.dll --version |& sed '1!d ; s/witty.er //') END_VERSIONS ]]>
